entities.name: Thomas J. Mabry
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas Jewett Mabry was an American attorney, politician and judge, who was chief justice of the New Mexico Supreme Court (1939–46) and the 14th governor of New Mexico, from 1947 to 1951.
